observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same engine from slightly different angles, placed on a concrete surface among other engines.
The engine has a silver and black plastic cover, with visible components including the alternator, pulleys, hoses, and wiring.
A barcode sticker is visible on the front of the engine block, but the text is not legible.
The engine appears used, with some grime and oil residue, and is not in a vehicle.
No visible branding or model number is readable on the engine block or components.
The seller claims it is a Toyota engine, but no Toyota logo or model name is visible in the photos.

claims.claim: Home of Toyota such as Toyota tundra Hilux Tacoma Camry Corolla direct tokubo first grade
claims.evidence: No visible Toyota branding or model name in the photos. The claim cannot be confirmed from the images.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Engine may not be from a Toyota vehicle as claimed
risks.proof: Clear photo of the engine block with visible brand/model name, or a VIN tag or part number that confirms Toyota origin.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic used engine, not a Toyota engine

risks.risk: Engine may be damaged or non-functional
risks.proof: Video or photo of the engine running, or a close-up of the internal components (e.g., cylinder head, crankshaft) to check for wear or damage.

risks.risk: Engine may have been salvaged from a wrecked or accident-damaged vehicle
risks.proof: Photo of the vehicle's VIN plate or a clear shot of the engine's serial number with the vehicle's registration details.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown origin, which reduces value

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine block showing the brand and model name.
Photo of the engine's serial number or VIN plate.
Video of the engine running or a close-up of the internal components.
Photo of the vehicle from which the engine was salvaged, if available.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
